justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/HttpHelper.java:48-57 and found `ContentType` is only a nested enum with 4 values (HTML, JSON, XML, TEXT) and no behavior of its own. The surrounding class handles the HTTP/redirect logic in separate methods (e.g. downloadViaHttp at lines 68-95), so `ContentType` is just a small type tag, not an overgrown or low-cohesion class. Call sites in android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/result/supplement/TitleRetriever.java:46-55, BookResultInfoRetriever.java:52-56, and ProductResultInfoRetriever.java:58-64 use it only to select the request MIME type.
